opportunities.name: Account brief email from SEC 10-K and Wikipedia
opportunities.description: For a given company ticker, look up latest 10-K filing date on SEC EDGAR, get HQ/employees/CEO from Wikipedia, and draft an account brief email to dana@example.com.
steps: Search ticker in SEC EDGAR company search and select the company
Open Form filter and the 10-K Annual report; note filing date
Search company name on Wikipedia and open article
Read HQ, employee count, CEO from infobox
Compose email to dana@example.com with subject 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Type body summarizing HQ, employees, CEO, latest 10-K date
Discard/send draft

instances.values: HUBS (SEC lookup started, no email seen)

opportunities.name: Supplier quote currency comparison email
opportunities.description: Convert two supplier quote amounts in different currencies to USD on Xe, check supplier city local time on timeanddate, and email a summary to procurement.
steps: Open Xe currency converter
Enter amount and select source currency, target USD, Convert
Repeat for second quote amount and currency
Open timeanddate and search supplier city for current time
Compose email to procurement@example.com with subject 'Quotes: <item>'
Body: both conversions, cheaper currency, supplier local time
Discard/send

8200 GBP vs 780000 INR, Pune, Shipping boxes

opportunities.name: Time zone and holiday sync email
opportunities.description: For two cities and a month, compute time difference with timeanddate converter, find holidays in the relevant country for that month, and email ops with the sync note.
steps: Open Time Zone Converter
Add city A and city B
Read time difference
Open Calendar > Holidays, pick the country
Note holiday dates in the target month
Compose email to ops@example.com with subject 'Sync: A / B, Month'
Body: time difference and dates to avoid
Discard/send

instances.values: San Francisco / Bangalore, October, India holidays
New York / Berlin, December, Germany holidays
